segments.he: וְכֵן בְּגֵירוּשִׁין, נָתַן לָהּ גִּיטָּהּ וְאָמַר לָהּ: ״הֲרֵי אַתְּ מְשׁוּלַּחַת״ ״הֲרֵי אַתְּ מְגוֹרֶשֶׁת״, ״הֲרֵי אַתְּ מוּתֶּרֶת לְכׇל אָדָם״ – הֲרֵי הִיא מְגוֹרֶשֶׁת. פְּשִׁיטָא נָתַן לָהּ גִּיטָּהּ, וְאָמַר לָהּ לְאִשְׁתּוֹ: ״הֲרֵי אַתְּ בַּת חוֹרִין״
segments.en: The Gemara returns to Shmuel’s statement. «And similarly, with regard to divorce:» If a husband «gave» his wife «her bill of divorce and said to her: You are hereby sent away,» or: «You are hereby divorced,» or: «You are hereby permitted to» marry «any man,» then «she is divorced.» The Gemara comments: It «is obvious» that if a husband «gave her a bill of divorce and said to his wife: You are hereby a free woman,»
